title: Perplexity Computer Brain now auto-creates self-improving agent skills
text:
Computer's personalized self-improvement agent, Brain, now automatically creates self-improving agent skills for you.

Brain learns how you work from past sessions and memory, then writes and updates personalized skills for future tasks.

related.title: Perplexity Computer's Brain now writes and updates self-improving agent skills.
related.text:
Sharing new research on self-improving skills in Perplexity Computer. Brain, which already maintains a knowledge wiki about your work, now also writes and updates agent skills for you based on your past sessions. An improvement agent reads the full session trajectories (tool calls, reasoning, results), finds recurring patterns, and only proposes a new skill or an update when there’s enough evidence. Built-in skills that every user gets go through paired replay on failure scenarios and engineer review before any change goes live. In an 8-week randomized test on production traffic, 72.9% of users got at least one new personal skill vs 6.5% who added one manually. Tool call failures dropped 11% and dissatisfied threads dropped 7.6%, with no measurable change in cost or latency.

Blog post with more details: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/self-improving-skills

These findings are helping us sharpen our defenses and support safeguards across the industry.

NVIDIA Research introduced WorldTrace to help video world models remember scenes.
text:
Look away and return to the same scene. For interactive video world models, preserving that consistency is a challenge.

WorldTrace from @NVIDIA Research helps models remember places without retraining, keeping spaces more consistent as users explore. On LoopBench, a benchmark for scene recall, it improves recall of revisited scenes by 32% over the standard sliding-window approach.

Read our #NeurIPS2026 paper ➡️

title: GIFs are now available in Gemini using Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash.
text:
Say hello to GIFs in Gemini. Say goodbye to searching for the perfect one.

From looping photo effects to funny memes, create any GIF you can imagine with our latest video model, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, for smooth motion and consistent quality across every frame.

GIFs are now available to all Google AI subscribers and free of charge in the U.S., Japan, Korea, Australia, Canada, U.K., Germany, and France.

Get started by prompting in the main chat or by selecting the image or video tool. Then, choose GIF in the format picker and describe what you want to make.
